Workshop Šlachy – od rehabilitace po výk: Tendons Workshop – From Rehabilitation to Performance | Radek Rosa
Workshop o šlachách s Tomášem Mihalíkem: A tendons workshop with Tomáš Mihalík and Radek Rosa: stiffness, tendinopathy, assessment and programming tendon training. Theory and practice.
Jak trénovat svaly víme - ale co šlachy?: We know how to train muscles – but what about tendons? They are essential for efficiently transferring force into every sporting movement. Neglecting them when planning training can limit performance and increase the risk of injuries that may keep an athlete out for weeks, months or even years. This workshop offers a unique connection between science and practice!
